Commercial Growth & Thought Leadership • Identify and cultivate expansion opportunities within accounts, connecting Mistral’s capabilities to new business challenges and driving commercial growth. • Mentor junior strategists and contribute to the development of best practices, methodologies, and playbooks for customer engagement. • Represent Mistral AI as a thought leader through speaking engagements, executive briefings, and industry contributions.
